csv_project_name: AE for Quandary Peak Trailhead Redesign
csv_scope_of_work: Summit County Government ( County ) and the Town of Breckenridge ( Town ) are soliciting bids from qualified contractors to provide services for the redesign of the Quandary Peak Trailhead. The project will be split into two phases: Phase 1 will focus on site assessments and data collection, and Phase 2 will focus on engineered designs and the preparation of construction-ready plans, specifications, and cost estimates (100% design). Contractor shall furnish all labor, transportation, and incidentals necessary to perform site assessments and the preliminary and final designs for the Quandary Peak Trailhead.
